text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah... Hehe!
The sound of the waves feels so good...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the beach for a break,
I spotted Silence Suzuka
sprinting along the water's edge.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how far it goes...
Yeah, let's run all the way to the end—"

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, dammit!!
We're settling this once and for all, hey!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Shut up. All you're good for is marking your territory.

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Friend A
text_block_list.text: These jerks went and called our training spot their "turf"! They're getting in the damn way!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
This is Seaside Todoroki Gang turf!
We ain't lendin' this place to you lot!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquent B
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about this? A 5-on-5, single-match showdown against Beeflacs!
If you beat us, we might just get out of your way.
In return, if you lose, you're our errand runners.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hah... a showdown, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
I'll knock you flat so you never open that trap again!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Together with us and Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ......Huh? M-Me?

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text:
Whew♪ Whoa, whoa, you sure about this~?
Isn't that girl totally terrified~?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Pokke!
Why am I being dragged into this showdown...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We're short one person.
You'd be in trouble too if you couldn't run, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That would be a problem, though...!
choice_data_list: Let's not compete, let's talk it out!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?!?
Who do you think you are, butting in when you can't even compete?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Words won't get through to 'em!
We gotta shut 'em up with pure skill!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, you bastards!
Show 'em who they picked a fight with!!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Friends
text_block_list.text: YEEAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...All I wanted was to run in peace, though...

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
One-match showdown at Big Flax! Ready...
Go!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Heh...!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text: Wha—the flag... vanished!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I got the flag.
That means it's my win, right?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, amazing! That's Suzuka for ya!
Her start is seriously insane fast!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew... Well then, I'll take my leave—

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH! Wait up!!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text:
It hit me right in the gut, man!
Your running did!! Toss her in the air, boys!
Let's celebrate this crazy-ass legend!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-Wait a second...!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! The trademark "Seaside Todoroki Squad"
triple victory toss!!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text:
Heaaave-ho!!
Heaaave-ho!!!
Heaaave-ho!!!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...
To strike awe into those guys, as expected of Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... I haven't done
anything worthy of being tossed in the air...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, just give it up.
Doesn't look like those guys are gonna settle down.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat... !?
choice_data_list: You were absolutely outstanding, you know!
You can run however you want in the place you've earned.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat... !?
choice_data_list: You were absolutely outstanding, you know!
You can run however you want in the place you've earned.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh no, even you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquent A
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure your legend lives on along this beach!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquent B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's like a killer whale—no, even faster!
More like 'Sailfish Suzuka'!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is that...?! Ugh, seriously, come on...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Please don't mind me~...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right.
I'm going to go now...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Then I'm going too!
Watching Suzuka run got me all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Local Delinquents
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!
Let us! Feast our eyes! On your running tooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why'd you follow me...
No way, are you serious!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Silence Suzuka picked up her pace, the delinquents got even more fired up...
And so, the game of chase continued until dusk.
